options: Send 2017 displacement comparison to routine archive

O.content: The title reads "Refugees vs IDPs"; the left vertical label "Refugees" is blue and the right vertical label "IDPs" is red.

O.location: plot area at the 2017 x-axis position
O.content: A blue circular mark is higher on the page than a red square mark at the vertical gridline labeled 2017.5, with the blue mark positioned near the 2017 year location and the red-square series also having a mark at that location.
The blue series is drawn with circular markers and the red series is drawn with square markers.

B.text: If the blue circular series is the Refugees series and the red square series is the IDPs series, and both series use the same vertically increasing count scale despite the separate colored axis labels, then the series whose 2017 mark is higher on the page has the larger 2017 people count; the task requires opening that category's follow-up record.
B.conditions: The color/axis-label association identifies the series, and the two vertical positions are numerically comparable. The chart shows no visible numeric y-axis ticks or explicit statement that the two colored axes share a scale, so comparability is an evidence gap.
